text:
sara-docs: Heads up: the /generate API page still shows `max_tokens` in streaming examples. Runtime uses `max_new_tokens` for streaming. Can we update the docs and snippets?

diego-eng: Yep. Implementation detail: streaming honors `max_new_tokens`. If both supplied, server uses `max_new_tokens`.

hannah-ml: Add a note about function-calling too: `max_new_tokens` limits model-generated tokens; function args and prompt still count toward the model's internal budget.

sara-docs: Draft line: "Prefer `max_new_tokens` for streaming; `max_tokens` is deprecated for streaming and will not affect streaming requests when `max_new_tokens` is provided." Good?

mei-pm: Sounds good. Add migration bullet in migration guide and a short JS/Python before->after.

tom-sdk: SDKs will keep accepting `max_tokens` for now; I'll add normalization (if `max_new_tokens` missing, set it to `max_tokens`) and log a deprecation warning once per process. Will update SDK snippets.

sara-docs: I'll replace curl/JS/Python examples and standardize response field name to `tokens_remaining` (we have `tokens_left` in some spots).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime/streaming-param-clarify 1:00 UTC.

tom-sdk: Also will make SDK parse both `tokens_left` and `remaining_tokens` and normalize to `tokens_remaining` for the next release cycle.

sara-docs: Checklist before PR: update generate ref, update snippets, add migration note + precedence line, standardize response field. Tagging @tom-sdk @diego-eng @hannah-ml for review.

diego-eng: I'll watch the deploy and confirm when runtime accepts `tokens_remaining` shape.

sara-docs: PR opened: docs(generate): prefer max_new_tokens for streaming + normalize response field. PTAL. :rocket:
